title: Prore
summary: PRORE, noun [Latin prora.] The prow or fore part of a ship. [Not in use, except in poetry.] Pro re nata, [Latin] according to exigencies or circumstances.

inlines.v: PRORE, noun [Latin prora.] The prow or fore part of a ship. [Not in use, except in poetry.] Pro re nata, [Latin] according to exigencies or circumstances.
